taxonomy_source.scope_note: This is an internal blocking taxonomy for broad modern-science wording. It is deliberately broader than the four current empirical lanes and must not be treated as proof that the taxonomy is exhaustive for public science classification.
taxonomy_source.closure_rule: A broad modern-science superiority claim requires every declared domain class and every required phenomenon class to have source-backed, target-separated benchmark lanes with preregistered comparators, uncertainty, controls, falsifiers, independent replay, and explicit domain-scope survey evidence.
